attrs.label: Image Selector
attrs.description:
The image to use.</br>
- Default Image: Runs inference on the CPU.</br>
- NVIDIA GPU Image: Runs inference on an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA).
Requires an NVIDIA GPU to be selected in the Resources section.

attrs.label: Whisper Model
attrs.description:
The Whisper model to use for transcription (WHISPER_MODEL).</br>
Use [auto] to let the server pick a model, or set a model name such as
[tiny-int8], [base], [small], [medium-int8], [large-v3] or [turbo],
or a Hugging Face model such as [Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3].</br>
Models are downloaded into the config storage on first use.

attrs.label: Language
attrs.description:
Code of the language that will be spoken (WHISPER_LANG),
for example [en] or [en-US]. Use [auto] to detect the language automatically.

attrs.label: Beam Size
attrs.description:
Number of candidates to consider simultaneously during transcription (WHISPER_BEAM).</br>
Higher values can improve accuracy, at the cost of speed.</br>
Use 0 to let the server pick (5 on x86, 1 on ARM).

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

1.0.0.readme:
Faster Whisper

Faster Whisper is a fast implementation of OpenAI's Whisper model, built on CTranslate2. This app runs the Wyoming Faster Whisper speech-to-text server, which can be added to Home Assistant through the Wyoming integration.

!!! WARNING !!!

This application requires additional elevated permissions beyond standard containerization protections. Use at your own risk.

The following additional privileges may be enabled from installing this application:

• Host Networking
